items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know him? ... [INTERVIEWEE] This is the trumpet player. Alvin talked about him.

ctx.x: But now I went to. M.E. I said, I've been. What about Kimball?
That trumpet player. I knew Kimball was that. Did you know him? I knew Kimball was bass player. No. No.
